tck-app--capture: page-variant marker on .tck-app root; layout owned by .tck-shell--capture/.tck-capture
tck-app--denied: page-variant marker on .tck-app root; layout owned by .tck-empty-state
tck-app--kiosk: page-variant marker on .tck-app root; layout owned by .tck-kiosk
tck-app--live: page-variant marker on .tck-app root; layout owned by .tck-main--live/.tck-live
tck-app--portal: page-variant marker on .tck-app root; layout owned by .tck-portal
tck-brand__icon: icon wrapper inside styled .tck-brand; glyph sized via .tck-brand__icon-svg
tck-brand__text: text wrapper inside styled .tck-brand; parts styled via __title/__subtitle/__role
tck-breadcrumb__brand: brand crumb link inside styled .tck-breadcrumb ol; styled via .tck-breadcrumb a
tck-capture__action: JS mount for corrective actions (data-tck-corrective); children emitted as styled .tck-btn/links
tck-capture__confirm: JS-toggled confirm panel (data-tck-confirm + .tck-hidden); children styled via __cpname + .tck-btn
tck-coach__state: state icon wrapper inside styled .tck-coach__step; glyph sized via .tck-icon
tck-kiosk__stage: JS stage-switch container (data-tck-stage=grid|pin|sign|confirm + .tck-hidden); children carry styling
tck-section: redundant marker on styled .tck-card (settings transfer sections)
tck-skip-link--nav: second skip-link target (#app-navigation); identical chrome as base .tck-skip-link
tck-transfer-report: marker on styled .tck-dialog; verdict styled via .tck-transfer-report__verdict
